location_latest_cleanup_fence_valid.name: location_latest_cleanup_fence_valid
location_latest_cleanup_fence_valid.value: ("location_latest"."worker_run_id" is not null and "location_latest"."cleanup_armed" is null) or ("location_latest"."worker_run_id" is null and "location_latest"."cleanup_armed" is not null and "location_latest"."cleanup_armed" = true)

location_latest_precision_valid.name: location_latest_precision_valid
location_latest_precision_valid.value: ("location_latest"."precision" = 'area' and "location_latest"."latitude" is null and "location_latest"."longitude" is null and "location_latest"."accuracy" is null) or ("location_latest"."precision" = 'precise' and "location_latest"."latitude" is not null and "location_latest"."longitude" is not null and "location_latest"."accuracy" is not null and "location_latest"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "location_latest"."longitude" between -180 and 180 and "location_latest"."accuracy" between 0 and 100000)

map_pins_text_valid.name: map_pins_text_valid
map_pins_text_valid.value: length("map_pins"."title") between 1 and 120 and length("map_pins"."address") <= 400 and length("map_pins"."attribution") <= 500 and length("map_pins"."license") <= 120 and length("map_pins"."place_key") = 64 and ("map_pins"."provider" is null or length("map_pins"."provider") <= 40) and ("map_pins"."provider_id" is null or length("map_pins"."provider_id") <= 1024)

trip_places_text_valid.name: trip_places_text_valid
trip_places_text_valid.value: length("trip_places"."title") between 1 and 120 and length("trip_places"."note") <= 1000 and length("trip_places"."address") <= 400 and length("trip_places"."attribution") <= 500 and length("trip_places"."license") <= 120

trip_places_default_title_valid.name: trip_places_default_title_valid
trip_places_default_title_valid.value: "trip_places"."default_title" is null or ("trip_places"."source" = 'pin' and "trip_places"."provider_id" is null and "trip_places"."default_title" ~ '^Checkpoint [1-9][0-9]*$' and length("trip_places"."default_title") <= 120)

trip_plans_context_valid.name: trip_plans_context_valid
trip_plans_context_valid.value: ("trip_plans"."room_id" is not null and "trip_plans"."personal_conversation_id" is null and "trip_plans"."sandbox_conversation_id" is null) or ("trip_plans"."room_id" is null and "trip_plans"."subroom_id" is null and "trip_plans"."personal_conversation_id" is not null and "trip_plans"."sandbox_conversation_id" is null) or ("trip_plans"."room_id" is null and "trip_plans"."subroom_id" is null and "trip_plans"."personal_conversation_id" is null and "trip_plans"."sandbox_conversation_id" is not null)

trip_routes_locks_valid.name: trip_routes_locks_valid
trip_routes_locks_valid.value: cardinality("trip_routes"."locked_positions") <= 200 and (cardinality("trip_routes"."locked_positions") = 0 or (array_ndims("trip_routes"."locked_positions") = 1 and array_position("trip_routes"."locked_positions", null) is null and 0 <= all("trip_routes"."locked_positions") and 200 > all("trip_routes"."locked_positions")))
